## What this is -- and is not

- This is a **reply parser only**. It does NOT update any calendar or database, does NOT send any WhatsApp message, and does NOT claim an appointment was actually changed -- it only reports what the customer's reply seems to say.
- **POST-only.** No Meta GET verification handshake or X-Hub-Signature-256 validation is implemented. Do not point Meta's webhook config directly at this URL as-is -- test with a synthetic HTTP client instead.
- Classification is deterministic word/phrase matching, not AI/ML. Conflicting or absent signals route to manual_review rather than guessing.
- Adapt keywords and languages to your business before relying on this.
